name: Binary Search
description: Repeatedly halves a sorted search space.

name: Linear Search
description: Scans each element until the target is found.

name: A* Search
description: Heuristic shortest path — game AI, maps, and pathfinding.

name: Bellman-Ford
description: Shortest paths with negative edges; used in distance-vector routing.

name: Dijkstra
description: Single-source shortest paths on non-negative weighted graphs (network routing).

name: Floyd-Warshall
description: All-pairs shortest paths — network topology and routing tables.

name: Bubble Sort
description: Adjacent elements are repeatedly swapped when out of order.

name: Counting Sort
description: Non-comparison sort using frequency counts — CLRS Ch8, bounded integer keys.

name: Heap Sort
description: Builds a max-heap and repeatedly extracts the largest element.

name: Insertion Sort
description: Builds a sorted prefix by inserting each element into place.

name: Merge Sort
description: Divides the array and merges sorted halves.

name: Quick Sort
description: Partitions around a pivot and recursively sorts subarrays.

name: Radix Sort
description: LSD radix sort by digit — CLRS Ch8, non-comparison stable sort.

name: Selection Sort
description: Repeatedly selects the smallest element and moves it forward.

name: Boyer-Moore
description: Right-to-left search with bad-character rule — CLRS Ch32, fast text search.

name: KMP Search
description: Linear-time substring search with prefix (LPS) table — parsing and intrusion detection.

name: Rabin-Karp
description: Rolling-hash substring search — CLRS Ch32, plagiarism detection.

name: Kruskal (MST)

name: Prim (MST)
description: Minimum spanning tree for network design and clustering.

name: Topological Sort
description: Linear ordering of a DAG — build systems and dependency graphs (SWE).
